Rubi Devi @ Rubi Kumari vs The State Of Jharkhand & Others
on 15 September, 2023

Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 1
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Transfer Petition (Crl.) No. 27 of 2022
 Rubi Devi @ Rubi Kumari ...... Petitioner
 Versus
The State of Jharkhand & Others
 ...... Opp. Parties

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sanjay Prasad, Advocate
For the State : Mrs. Amrita Banerjee, A.C. to G.P.-1

For the O.P. Nos. 2 and 3: Mr. Rahul Pandey, Advocate
10/Dated: 15/09/2023

This petition has been filed for transfer of G.R. Case No. 1401 of 2019 arising out Haider Nagar P.S. Case No. 94 of 2019 for the offence under sections 341, 325, 307, 506, 498A, 34 of the I.P.C. and under section 3 & 4 of the D.P. Act, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Daltonganj to the Civil Court, Dhanbad.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Maintenance Case being OMC No. 192 of 2019 has already been transferred from the Court of Family Court, Daltonganj to the Family Court, Dhanbad by order dated 19.04.2023 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Transfer Petition (Crl.) No. 10 of 2021.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is having new born child and residing at Dhanbad along with her father and she has no means to move to Daltonganj, in view of that this petition may be allowed.

entities.text: Rubi Devi @ Rubi Kumari vs The State Of Jharkhand & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the O.P. Nos. 2 and 3 submits that the said case may not be transferred.
He submits that the O.P. Nos. 2 and 3 are also suffering from financial crisis.
4. It appears that one case has already been transferred with regard to maintenance case and the O.P. No.2 is staying at Dhanbad.
The petitioner is wife and she is having no means to move before the competent Court of Daltonganj as has been disclosed that she is dependent upon her parents and a new born child is there.

It appears that no prejudice will cause to the O.P. Nos. 2 and 3 if the present case is transferred to the competent court of Dhanbad jurisdiction as one case is already there with regard to maintenance.

The G.R. Case No. 1401 of 2019 arising out Haider Nagar P.S. Case No. 94 of 2019, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Daltonganj is directed to be transferred to the competent Court at Dhanbad.
6. It is open to the O.P. Nos. 2 and 3 to make prayer before the learned Court at Dhanbad to fix both the cases on the same date so that they may attend in both the cases in one day at Dhanbad.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/
